import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

lemma prod_rpow {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) 
  (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ x i) : (∏ i in s, x i) ^ r = ∏ i in s, x i ^ r := by
  induction s using Finset.induction
  · -- Base case: empty set
    simp [one_rpow]
  · -- Inductive step: insert element
    intro i si hi IH
    rw [Finset.prod_insert si, IH, mul_rpow]
    · -- Prove 0 ≤ x i
      exact hx i hi
    · -- Prove 0 ≤ ∏ j in si, x j
      apply Finset.prod_nonneg
      intro j hj
      exact hx j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · -- Case n = 0
    subst hn
    simp [Finset.sum_range_zero, Finset.prod_range_zero]
    norm_num
  · -- Case n > 0
    have h_pos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    
    -- Define functions for AM-GM
    let z : ℕ → ℝ := fun x => (a x : ℝ)
    
    -- Define normalized weights v i = 1 / n
    let v : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => 1 / (n : ℝ)
    
    -- Verify non-negativity of values
    have h_z_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, 0 ≤ z i := by
      intro i hi
      exact NNReal.coe_nonneg (a i)
      
    -- Verify non-negativity of weights
    have h_v_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, 0 ≤ v i := by
      intro i hi
      simp [v]
      positivity
      
    -- Verify sum of weights is 1
    have h_v_sum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i = 1 := by
      simp [v, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
      field_simp [hn]
      <;> norm_cast
      <;> linarith
      
    -- Apply Weighted AM-GM inequality
    have h_ineq : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i ^ v i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i * z i := by
      apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
      · exact h_v_nonneg
      · exact h_v_sum
      · exact h_z_nonneg
      
    -- Simplify LHS: ∏ z i ^ (1/n) = (∏ z i) ^ (1/n)
    have h_lhs_simpl : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i ^ v i = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i ^ v i = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          simp [v]
        _ = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
          apply prod_rpow
          exact h_z_nonneg
          
    -- Simplify RHS: ∑ (1/n) * z i = (1/n) * ∑ z i
    have h_rhs_simpl : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i * z i = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i := by
      calc
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, v i * z i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * z i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          simp [v]
        _ = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          
    -- Calculate sum of z i
    have h_sum_z : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i = (n : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i : ℝ)) := by simp [z]
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i : NNReal : ℝ) := by simp [Finset.sum_coe]
        _ = (n : NNReal : ℝ) := by
          rw [h₀]
        _ = (n : ℝ) := by simp

      calc

          rw [← h_lhs_simpl]

        _ = 1 := by field_simp [hn]
        
    -- Deduce product <= 1

      have h_n_pos : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by exact_mod_cast h_pos
      have h_div_pos : (1 / (n : ℝ)) > 0 := by positivity
      have h_prod_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i := by
        apply Finset.prod_nonneg
        intro i hi
        exact h_z_nonneg i hi
      have h_le : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := h_main
      have h_imp : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i) ≤ 1 := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_one_iff.mp
        · exact h_prod_nonneg
        · exact h_div_pos
        · exact h_le
      exact h_imp
      
    -- Cast back to NNReal
    have h_final : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast h_prod_le
      
    exact h_final
